meta.name: Audit procurement compliance with Google Sheets, Google Gemini, and Gmail

nodes.name: Edit Fields - Enrich Audit Metadata
nodes.notes: Adds audit_id, timestamp, review period, and auditor tag to each procurement record before compliance checks.

nodes.name: Merge Procurement & Rules
nodes.notes: Synchronization point: waits for BOTH Procurement Data (Input 0) and Regulatory Rules (Input 1) before proceeding. Uses Append mode to pass all items downstream.

nodes.name: Code - Compliance Engine
nodes.notes: Core compliance engine. Checks each procurement transaction against ALL regulatory rules. Detects: GDPR violations, SOX threshold breaches, labor law non-compliance, anti-bribery gaps, expired contracts, and missing due diligence.

nodes.name: Edit Fields - Compose Final Output
nodes.notes: SECOND EDIT FIELDS NODE: Reconstructs all compliance data from Code node, captures AI report from OpenAI, and adds computed fields: priority_flag, escalation_required, sla_deadline, alert_id, assigned_to.

assignments.name: priority_flag
assignments.value: ={{ $('Code - Compliance Engine').item.json.risk_level === 'Critical' ? 'P1 - URGENT' : $('Code - Compliance Engine').item.json.risk_level === 'High' ? 'P2 - HIGH' : $('Code - Compliance Engine').item.json.risk_level === 'Medium' ? 'P3 - MEDIUM' : 'P4 - LOW' }}

assignments.name: sla_deadline
assignments.value: ={{ $('Code - Compliance Engine').item.json.risk_level === 'Critical' ? $now.plus({days: Number($('Edit Fields - Enrich Audit Metadata').first().json.sla_days_critical || 7)}).format('yyyy-MM-dd') : $('Code - Compliance Engine').item.json.risk_level === 'High' ? $now.plus({days: Number($('Edit Fields - Enrich Audit Metadata').first().json.sla_days_high || 14)}).format('yyyy-MM-dd') : $now.plus({days: Number($('Edit Fields - Enrich Audit Metadata').first().json.sla_days_medium || 30)}).format('yyyy-MM-dd') }}

nodes.name: IF - Non-Compliance Detected
nodes.notes: Routes Non-Compliant transactions to BOTH the Alert sheet AND the Report sheet. Compliant transactions go only to the Report sheet.

nodes.name: Google Sheets - Log Compliance Alert
nodes.notes: Writes non-compliant alerts to Compliance_Alerts sheet tab. Only receives items from the TRUE branch of the IF node.

nodes.name: Google Sheets - Store Audit Report
nodes.notes: Stores ALL audit reports (both compliant and non-compliant) to Audit_Reports sheet tab. Receives items from BOTH the TRUE and FALSE branches of the IF node.

nodes.name: Store AI Batch Report
nodes.notes: Stores ALL audit reports (both compliant and non-compliant) to Audit_Reports sheet tab. Receives items from BOTH the TRUE and FALSE branches of the IF node.

parameters.content:
#  Procurement Regulatory Compliance Audit

**How it works:**
On a schedule, this workflow pulls procurement transactions and regulatory rules from Google Sheets, then checks every transaction against six compliance areas — Data Protection (GDPR), Financial Compliance (SOX), Labor Law, Anti-Bribery (FCPA), Contract Management, and Due Diligence. Code - Compliance Engine scores each transaction's risk and flags violations. Generate AI Compliance Audit Report then uses Google Gemini to write a complete narrative audit report. Non-compliant transactions are logged as alerts, every result is saved to Google Sheets, and a formatted HTML email is sent automatically.

**Setup steps:**
1. Connect your Google Sheets OAuth2, Gmail OAuth2, and Google Gemini API credentials on the relevant nodes.
2. Open Edit Fields - Enrich Audit Metadata and update the alert email, high-risk countries, thresholds, and SLA day settings to match your policy.
3. Point Fetch Procurement Data and Fetch Regulatory Rules to your own spreadsheet and sheet tabs.
4. Set your preferred run schedule on Initiate Scheduled Compliance Audit.
5. Activate the workflow.

Follow the numbered notes below (1 to 5) to see what each group of nodes does.

### 1. Trigger, Data Sources & Configuration
Initiate Scheduled Compliance Audit starts the run. Fetch Procurement Data and Fetch Regulatory Rules pull data from their sheet tabs. Edit Fields - Enrich Audit Metadata stamps each record and holds editable settings: alert email, high-risk countries, thresholds, and SLA days.

### 2. Compliance Engine Core
Merge Procurement & Rules combines enriched transactions with regulatory rules. Code - Compliance Engine checks every transaction against GDPR, SOX, Labor Law, Anti-Bribery, Contract Management, and Due Diligence rules, scoring risk. Validate Batch Summary Record separates the one batch summary record from individual results.

### 3. AI Narrative Report
Generate AI Compliance Audit Report uses Google Gemini Chat Model to turn the batch summary into a full, structured audit narrative with an executive summary, risk dashboard, and a remediation action plan.

### 4. Compliance Routing & Storage
IF - Non-Compliance Detected checks each transaction. Non-compliant ones are written to Google Sheets - Log Compliance Alert. Every transaction, compliant or not, is also saved to Google Sheets - Store Audit Report for a full audit trail.

### 5. Final Output & Notification
Edit Fields - Compose Final Output assembles the AI report with all batch metadata. Email Compliance Audit Report sends a formatted HTML summary to the configured recipient, while Store AI Batch Report saves the complete report to the AI_Batch_Reports sheet tab.
